ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Убийство» (ubiystvo, 'murder, killing') is 'murder' throughout, and the closing thought keeps «убийцы» (ubiytsy, 'murderers'), which the website draft had dropped. The prophets and Gospel verses are translated from the Russian wording, not from an English Bible: «правда» (pravda, 'truth, right') in Isaiah is 'right' beside «истина» (istina, 'truth') and «правосудие» (pravosudie, 'justice'), and «господь» (gospod', 'lord') stays lowercase as printed.
